# Showband Group

> Showband Group — Bakıda toy, nişan, korporativ tədbir, ad günü və party üçün canlı musiqi: instrumental band, DJ, showman, müğənni, səs-işıq və şou proqramı. Azərbaycanın rayonlarında və xaricdə də çıxış edir.

Showband Group (Baku, Azerbaijan) is a live music and event show band for weddings, corporate events, birthdays and parties. Services: instrumental band, DJ, showman/host, singer or guitarist, flash mob, event script, sound and light (laser & LED) show. Performs across Azerbaijan and abroad.

Booking: WhatsApp +994 55 611 87 87 (https://wa.me/994556118787), Instagram https://www.instagram.com/showband_group/, or the form at https://showbandgroup.az/#bron

## Packages (starting prices, Baku)

- Toy (wedding) package — from 500 AZN per hour: DJ · showman, instrumental band, flash mob, event script, props (LED glasses, flash-mob sticks, money gun, hand fireworks). Add-ons: sound, light and stage; decoration; photo, video and Love Story.
- Corporate package — from 1500 AZN: guitarist or singer, sound system, contests, laser & LED light show. Add-ons: decoration and brand design, photo and video.
- Birthday / party package — from 800 AZN: guitarist or singer, sound system, contests, laser & LED light show.

Prices may differ for regions outside Baku, holidays and special dates.
